leaguecheck.desc: v167 — the league is real: a season's league of named, rated teams (16 at the Interstellar level) and its round-robin; every week's opponent is that week's league team at its rating; the AI games go by rating on a seeded stream (stable table; rating vs final rank Spearman ≥ .55 over 160 leagues); the title-game opponent comes from the top of the table (rating percentile ≥ .7, winning record, the #1/#2 AI team in a semifinal field); the schedule rows' records, the standings screen, the scorebug's records; TU v167league 0 = the old weekly draws. No page errors.

No page errors.
